tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Doctor Diaz
professor.text: This week, we discussed the importance of role models in society. One idea we discussed was the widespread impact of “ influencers.” Influencers are people who are very active posting on social media and who have many followers. Influencers‘ posts and opinions can influence their followers’ choices on everything from fashion to politics. In your opinion, do social media influencers generally have a positive or negative effect on their followers? Why do you think so?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I think the influencers‘ effect is generally positive. People can learn about the latest trends and topics in a very quick and efficient way by following influencers. In the past, people had to spend time looking through magazines or visiting boutiques to even know what was trending.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I think influencers generally have a negative effect because they have far too much influence. I can think of one influencer who only has to mention a particular kind of sports shoes, and the next day they’ll be sold out. The followers aren’t really thinking for themselves; they’re just blindly following their influencers’ choices.

tasks.sample: I believe that social media influencers generally have a positive effect on their followers. First, influencers provide a fast and efficient way for people to stay updated on the latest trends, ideas, and news. Through their posts, followers gain access to new products, fashion, and lifestyle tips that they might not have discovered otherwise. This can help individuals make informed choices and stay connected to the world around them. Moreover, influencers often use their platform to promote social causes, share motivational messages, and offer educational content. To be more specific, many influencers use their popularity to raise awareness about important issues like mental health, environmental sustainability, and social justice. This helps educate their followers, encouraging them to care more about society and motivating them to take action. Over time, this can have a positive impact on society.
